main_text.l: totum tractum, quo nunc Silesia, Marchia, Prussia,
Mekelburgæ, Pomerania, & Holsatia continentur, imperio suo subjecisse & Gneznam civi-
dicta, fundasse, dicitur. Quis ipsi fuccesse-
rit, nescitur: hoc tantum scribunt, Vifimirum
Dantiscum, & alias quasdam urbes victo Dano-
rum Rege Sivardo, condidisse. Devenit post annos
XII Palatinos regimen, quod difcordiis dilacer-
versibus concripsit: Dionysius Abbas, qui palam
rmat: Arator, Romanæ Ecclesiæ subdiaconus, qui
Prisciamus Cæsariensis, qui Grammaticæ artis professor
medicæ studio Græciam, Tuscam, Galliam, Hi-
o Sapiens, Brandanus Scotus, qui septem nali navigatione fortunatas infulas requisivit: Procopius, qui nobis Historiam de bellis Persarum, Vandalorum & Gothorum
reliquit, &c. Tum etiam Antiochia terræ motu corruit, & IVMDCCC homines obruti sunt. Pesti sanguinaria, orta in Æthiopia universum orbem pervafit. Pompejopolis

page.notes: Marginal notes on the left are partly illegible (Gremerus lib.1; Varia; Diaconus; Cassiodor. divinar.; Sigebert; Procop. l. 2. de bello Vandal.; Aal.). Several words in the text are badly damaged and transcribed with best reading; some lines near the bottom right are faint.
